name_cn: 河北盖帛纺织有限公司
main_products: Cotton and TC shirting, cotton and TC workwear fabric, TR shirting and suiting, TC pocketing, voile, TC/CVC yarn
woven_evidence: The company says it runs 300 air-jet looms (a weaving loom) making shirting, workwear and suiting fabric.

canton_fair.evidence_note: Named as a Shijiazhuang exhibitor at the 137th Canton Fair in a texnet.com.cn report.

notes: It claims 120,000 spindles and 3M m of fabric a month (self-reported, and its staff numbers differ between pages). It appears on the NDRC 2025 cotton import quota applicant list, which supports that it is a real spinning and weaving mill in Zhao County.
